name: kringkasting
description: Kringkasting – RSS feeds for NRK's podcasts with full episode archives (kringkast.ing)

paragraphs: Kringkasting turns NRK's podcast catalog into open RSS feeds and enables you to use any podcast app that supports feeds to listen to their podcasts. Find a podcast, choose your favorite podcasting app, and subscribe. Simple as that.

NRK makes its podcasts only available through its own closed app and web. They really, really don't want to support the podcasting standard. As a tax-funded public broadcaster, that's a pretty crazy thing to do and it even contradicts §31 in their own articles of association which states that NRK should, insofar as possible, use open standards if not hindered by financial or qualitative considerations. There is an open podcast standard and it is called RSS.

Kringkasting is the solution to this problem. It is an open-source app independent of NRK and it uses NRK's public API to create a open standard compliant podcast feed of their feeds. It does not select or rewrite the editorial content. It just opens the closed tax-financed podcasts up to everyone. You can use the kringkast.ing demo, install this on your own server, NAS or self-host it in the cloud.
